title: TPR-Attention for Combinatorial Generalization
abstract: arXiv:2608.30124v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Systematic generalization remains a significant challenge in deep learning. In particular, combinatorial generalization - generalizing to new configurations of known factors of variation - is effortless for humans but difficult for standard neural architectures that rely on statistical correlations rather than explicit structural representations. We introduce a new architectural component that embeds structured inductive bias into deep learning: an attention mechanism operating over tensor-product representations (TPRs). Through controlled experiments on compositional tasks, we show that this TPR-attention mechanism outperforms existing architectural components in combinatorial generalization. These results highlight the value of integrating explicit compositional structure into neural attention and point toward a promising path for models capable of systematic generalization.

translated_title: 用于组合泛化的张量积表示注意力机制（TPR-Attention）
translated_abstract: 系统性泛化仍然是深度学习中的一项重大挑战。特别是组合泛化——即泛化到已知变化因素的新组合配置——对人类来说轻而易举，但对依赖统计相关性而非显式结构表示的标准神经架构来说却十分困难。我们引入了一种新的架构组件，将结构化归纳偏置嵌入到深度学习中：一种作用于张量积表示（TPR）的注意力机制。通过在组合任务上的受控实验，我们证明了这种TPR注意力机制在组合泛化方面优于现有的架构组件。这些结果凸显了将显式组合结构集成到神经注意力机制中的价值，并为构建具备系统性泛化能力的模型指出了一条有前景的路径。
tldr: 该论文提出了一种基于张量积表示（TPR）的注意力机制，通过将显式组合结构嵌入神经注意力中，显著提升了模型在组合泛化任务上的表现。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes an attention mechanism operating over tensor-product representations (TPRs), which embeds explicit compositional structure into neural attention and significantly outperforms existing architectural components in combinatorial generalization.
